conceptual_statement: Georgia research stays in six specialist grains: DPS MCA household-goods identities, unlicensed-practice cease-and-desist orders, NMLS mortgage licensing, OCI insurer events, CMS care settings, and Securities Division orders. Ask routes to those pages. It does not add them into one Georgia business, provider, or professional total.

release_gate.rule: All six specialist /georgia pages must return HTTP 200 as intended state intelligence pages, indexable and self-canonical, before Ask /georgia is indexable. Any one specialist failure fails the gate.

intelligence_strip.grain: Licensed household-goods certificate identity, not USDOT. 572 deduped location rows. Exact USDOT joins: 0. Listing is not inferred Active status.
Not a contractor census. Statewide licensing rosters were not acquired. Orders are not joined to profiles by name.

intelligence_strip.display: Georgia DBF mortgage licensing is verified through NMLS
intelligence_strip.grain: No acquired Georgia company census. Mortgage broker, mortgage lender, branch, and MLO stay separate. HMDA is not a lender count.
7 index companies since September 2010 plus 2 later announcements. Exact NAIC attachments: 0. Not a Georgia insurer, agency, or producer census.
Separately 105 CMS Home Health and 261 CMS Hospice. Do not publish 722 Georgia senior facilities. State care-setting rosters were not acquired.
Standalone events. Exact profile attachments: 0. A caption is not a finding. 364 SEC/IARD Georgia principal-office firms are not state registration.

what_makes_georgia_different: Move: the public identity is the Georgia DPS MCA, not a USDOT. Tariff No. 7 effective 2026-01-13 covers intrastate household goods.
Contractor: the acquired state evidence is 36 cease-and-desist orders, not a license roster.
Lender: DBF uses NMLS. No second Georgia lender census was built.
Insurance: HB410 eliminated branch-agency licensing. Receivership events stay unattached.
Senior: CMS nursing home, home health, and hospice stay separate from unacquired DCH state classes.
Investor: IARD, IAPD, and BrokerCheck remain the identity spine. The state layer is the Securities Orders index.

CROSS_HUB_RECORD_TOTAL.explanation: The six hubs contain companies, people, facilities, license identities, location rows, evidence events, enforcement orders, and federal activity observations. Those grains cannot be summed into Georgia businesses, providers, licensed companies, professionals, or Trust Hub records.
